spec.data_source: Native IAM provider list and GetAccountAuthorizationDetails role trust documents.
spec.predicate: A current native role trust declares the exact provider and compatible STS federation action. Complete current native role trust inventory has no declared consumer of this provider.
spec.title: SAML provider has a role consumer
spec.description: Reviews current IAM SAML provider role consumers using complete account-wide native role trust inventory. An Allow trust statement naming the exact provider ARN with the matching STS federation action establishes a declared consumer even when conditions apply. Complete role enumeration and every valid trust document are required for structural absence; partial, denied, malformed, wildcard or negative-principal semantics leave absence unresolved. This does not measure authentication history or establish safe deletion.
spec.remediation_hint: Review provider ownership and remove obsolete federation providers after confirming intended consumers.
